english:
...God. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "All [the ends of the earth] have seen." Epistle 2 Timothy 4:8: "Make haste to come..." to verse 22: "with you. Amen."
Alleluia: of the Fast. Gospel John 7:14: "About the middle of the feast..." to verse 23: "I healed [a man] on the Sabbath."

Saturday. Of Saint Isaac Parthev, our Patriarch. Tone 8 [dk]: "True Root" (Armat chshmarit). Say the Canticle of the Grandchildren, Tone 1 [ak]: "O divine light." Processional and Evening Hymn Tone 6 [gk]: "Who from the roots." Midday Hymn Tone 8 [dk]: "Good Shepherd." Psalm: "Thy priests." Proverbs Wisdom 7:12: "I rejoiced in them all..." to verse 18: "the cycles of times." Prophet Isaiah 61:9: "And they shall be named..." to verse 7 [61:7]: "upon their heads." Epistle Hebrews 13:17: "Obey [your leaders]..." to verse 21: "forever. Amen." Alleluia: "You are a priest." Gospel John 10:11: "I am the good shepherd..." to verse 16: "and one shepherd."

Sunday. Canticle Tone 8 [dk]: "Who in awesome form." Magnificat: "Mother of Light, Mother of God." Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to thee." Prophet Isaiah 63:18: "Our adversaries..." to 64:12: "[wilt thou restrain] us to the uttermost." Epistle Titus 1:1: "Paul, a servant..." to verse 11: "for shameful gain." Alleluia: of the Resurrection. Gospel John 7:37: "On the last day..." to verse 52: "no [prophet] is to rise from Galilee."

Monday. Of the Holy Saints: Bishop Mark, Priest Pion, Deacons Cyril and Benjamin, and the Martyrs Abdelmesih, Ormizdan, and Sayen. Tone and Canticle of Martyrs. Midday Psalm: "Thy priests." Prophet Zechariah 8:1: "And the word of the Lord came..." to verse 3: "holy mountain." Epistle Romans 8:28: "But we know..." to verse 39: "in our Lord." Alleluia: "Thy priests." Gospel John 15:17: "These things I command..." to verse 21: "him who sent me."

Tuesday. Of the Holy Ghevondian Priests. Tone 7 [dz]: "Who beforehand." Canticle Tone 8 [dk]: "Who unceasingly." Magnificat: of the Patriarch Abraham. Processional Tone 6 [gk]: "Ineffable." Evening Hymn Tone 3 [bz]: "We swear to you." Midday Introit: "In the worldly." Hymn Tone 7 [dz]: "They shone forth." Psalm: "Thy priests." Proverbs Wisdom 5:16: "But the righteous..." to verse 23: "shall wash away relentlessly." Prophet Isaiah 35:1: "Be glad..." to verse 2: "of our God." Again, Isaiah 61:6: "But you shall be called priests..." to verse 7: "upon their heads." Epistle 1 Peter Catholic [Epistle] 1:3: "Blessed be God..." to verse 9: "the salvation of souls." Alleluia: "Thy priests." Gospel Luke 12:4: "But I say to you..." to verse 10: "it shall not be forgiven him."

Wednesday. Canticle of Rest Tone 7 [gd]: "Who with glory." Midday Psalm 65 [66]: "Save thy servant." Epistle Titus 1:12: "One of them said..." to 2:10: "they may adorn in all things." Alleluia: of the Fast. Gospel John 8:12: "Again he spoke..." to verse 20: "his hour had come."

Thursday. Of the Holy Vardanank Generals and our one thousand thirty-six martyrs who were perfected in the great battle. Tone 8 [dk]: "Wondrously new" (Norahrash), say "Ineffable" (zAncharelin) at the end. Canticle Tone 8 [dk]: "Who unceasingly." Processional and Evening Hymn Tone 8 [dk], melody [steghi]: "Emboldened" (Ariatsialqk). Midday Introit: "In the worldly." Hymn Tone 6 [gk]: "Sun" (Aregakn). Psalm 43 [44]: "Thou hast made us like sheep." Proverbs Wisdom 3:1: "But the souls of the righteous..." to verse 8: "the Lord forever." Prophet Isaiah 49:8: "Thus says the Lord to Israel..." to verse 9: "their pasture." Epistle Hebrews 12:1: "Therefore since we also..." to verse 7: "God is treating you." Alleluia: of Martyrs. Gospel Luke 6:20: "And he lifted up..." to verse 26: "their fathers."

Friday. Canticle of Rest Tone 8 [dk]: "Eternal God." Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends [of the earth] have seen." Epistle Titus 3:1: "And remind them..." to verse 15: "[grace be with] you all. Amen." Alleluia: of the Fast. Gospel John 8:21: "Again he said to them..." to verse 30: "believed in him."

Saturday. Of the Holy One Hundred and Fifty Patriarchs of the Holy Council of Constantinople. Tone 5 [gz]: "Today the holy patriarchs..." with its proper canons. Processional Tone 5 [gz]: "O wondrous." Midday Introit: "Of the Patriarchs." Hymn Tone 7 [dz]: "Today the heavenly hosts." Psalm: "Thy priests." Prophet...
